description: Lists phone calls the Neuron receptionist answered, newest first, and returns from, to, count, truncated, and items. Each item has id, at (ISO time), caller { name, phone }, durationSec, reason, outcome ('booked' or 'answered'), endedReason, and engine ('neuron' or 'vapi'). Use it for phone-call questions and outcomes; use neuron_leads for inbound leads from calls, website forms, texts, or other channels, neuron_inbox for email, and neuron_contacts to find a specific customer. It looks BACKWARD at when the call came in, defaults to the last 7 days ending now, permits a window of at most 90 days, and returns at most 500 calls; truncated is true when the cap was reached, so narrow the window. Test and synthetic records are excluded; this Neuron Expert MCP server tool is read-only, reads only the one business whose owner approved the connection and granted read:calls on the consent screen, and returns JSON objects also as text. The limit is 60 requests per minute per connection, and a refused read returns a tool error with a short reason text.

from.description: Start of the window: an ISO 8601 date (2026-11-01) or date-time (2026-11-01T00:00:00Z). Default: 7 days before to; it must not be after to, and the window is at most 90 days.

to.description: End of the window: an ISO 8601 date or date-time. Default: now; it is at most 90 days after from.

name: neuron_calls

truncated.description: True when the read stopped at its row cap (500; contact search 25).

title: List calls
